detail: Verified via git archaeology across every commit touching src/engine/archiver.ts (1135323 → d495bd9 → 2887e01 → 1ea8d01 → dfd6add/1.24.0): the loop summary post has ALWAYS been entry_type "finding", summary `Archive: ${n} entries archived` (src/engine/archiver.ts:102), tags ["archive"] (line 104), scope "project" (line 105), detail starting `Archive summary: ${n} entries archived.` (buildSummary, line 127). agent_id has always defaulted to "main" (src/engine/blackboard.ts:98, unchanged since db64f9c) and the archiver never passes one. Archive file naming has always been archive/{YYYY-MM-DD}-blackboard.jsonl — no legacy naming variants exist. Compaction can therefore match the full 6-field signature with near-zero risk of dropping human/agent-authored entries.
summary: #35 junk signature stable across all archiver history: finding + "Archive: N entries archived" + tags [archive] + scope project + agent_id main + detail "Archive summary: N..."
